text: main function mspca(). Inputs (following elasticnet convention, data single argument M plus type selector): M: data matrix, type: "Sigma" (default) treats M covariance/correlation matrix (p x p); "X" treats M raw data matrix (n observations x p variables), r: number sparse principal components, ks: integer vector length r sparsity budgets. type = "X", mspca() applies algorithm data directly via products t(X) %*% (X %*% beta) never forms p x p matrix, reduces iteration’s matrix–vector product O(p^2) O(np). Pass type = "X" number variables greatly exceeds number observations; n > p dense type = "Sigma" path cheaper. Output fields: x_best: sparse loading matrix (p x r), objective_value, feasibility_violation, runtime, feasibilityConstraintType: constraint enforced, reused default diagnostics, nonredundancy: pairwise violation matrices constraint definitions, computed fit time. title: msPCA 0.5.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-06-25 mspca() tpm() now take two possible inputs: covariance/correlation matrix data matrix directly. practice, functions take single generic argument M together type = c("Sigma", "X") selector. type = "Sigma" (default) treats M covariance/correlation matrix (p x p); type = "X" treats M raw data matrix (n observations x p variables). "Sigma" default preserves behaviour existing matrix-based calls. raw-data path applies algorithm data directly: product Sigma %*% beta evaluated t(X) %*% (X %*% beta) / (n - 1) cost O(np), p x p matrix never materialized. substantially improves scalability n << p. covariance back-end refactored behind covariance-operator abstraction (DenseOp / GramOp) shared input modes. Added preprocessing controls type = "X": center, scale (covariance vs correlation), divisor (“n-1” “n”). Added validation input modes: Sigma input checked squareness, symmetry positive semidefiniteness (checkPSD, symTolerance, psdTolerance); X input checked finiteness, dimensions (scaling) zero-variance columns. mspca() results now include variance_explained (per-PC) total_variance; X-mode results also record inputType, center, scale, divisor, nObs p. mspca() tpm() now return S3 objects class "mspca" "tpm" respectively, enabling use standard R generics. Added print.mspca(): S3 print method displaying sparse loading matrix restricted union active variables, percentage variance explained per PC, number non-zero loadings. Replaces removed print_mspca(). Added summary.mspca(): produces per-PC table sparsity, variance explained, FVE, cumulative FVE, followed full pairwise feasibility violation matrix. Updated citation
